observations.body: Signed-out Login shows Username and Password fields and a Sign in button; it lists emily.dawson as the Employee demo account.
Signed-out Login is ready to submit with the configured Employee credentials.
Submitting the configured Employee credentials signed in and displayed the Employee dashboard.

Employee Dashboard shows navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile, quick links to Request leave and Fill timesheet, a Notifications button, and Log out. It showed pending leave requests 0; leave-balance value was still loading.
My Leave shows a New request link, an available balance of 18 days, and request history with an approved Vacation request dated Aug 18–19, 2026 for 3 days and manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.
New Leave Request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal types; required Start date and End date fields; optional Reason; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
Start date and End date are empty; the form is otherwise displayed and has evaluation-data text in Reason.
The initial Submit request click was not executed: the open date picker intercepted it and the browser admitted no application request.
Vacation dates Sep 29-30, 2026 and evaluation-data reason are present; the form displays Duration: 2 days.

Submitting the evaluation-data Vacation request returned to My Leave. The history then showed a pending request as “Sep 29, 2026 – Sep 29, 2026”, 2 days, Vacation; available balance changed to 16 days.
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs all at 0, Total 0 h, Save draft, and Submit week.
My Profile offers Upload photo, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a disabled Email field, and Save changes.

Employee Directory loaded 28 employees in a table with Name, Department, Title, and Email columns. It offers name search, an All departments filter with five department choices, name sorting, and three pages; Previous was disabled on page 1 and Next was offered.
